image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a large marine mammal, identified as a grey whale, surfacing in dark water. The image captures the dorsal side of the whale's body, showing dark, mottled skin with lighter patches (likely barnacles or cyamids) and a distinct lack of a dorsal fin, replaced by a series of low humps (knuckles). White sea foam and splashing water obscure the lower boundary where the whale meets the ocean.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The head and rostrum are not visible in this frame; the image focuses on the mid-to-posterior dorsal section.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The visible skin exhibits the characteristic dark grey/black coloration with irregular lighter/white mottling consistent with barnacle clusters.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: There is clearly no triangular dorsal fin. Instead, a series of small, rounded humps (knuckles) are visible along the ridge of the back, matching the species description.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Consistent with previous checkpoint; texture and coloration match.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Pectoral fins are located on the ventral/lateral side and are not visible in this dorsal view.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Tail flukes are broad with smooth trailing edge and central notch.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The tail flukes are outside the frame.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Skin texture is rough with callosities.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The surface appears uneven and textured, consistent with the rough skin and parasite load of a grey whale, though resolution limits fine detail verification.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The transition between the whale's skin and the white sea foam is slightly soft and 'smudged,' lacking the crisp physical separation expected in a high-speed splash. This may be due to image compression or slight AI generation blur, but it is subtle.

The water in the foreground and background has a uniform, painterly smoothness that lacks the complex refraction and detail of real ocean water, suggesting potential generative smoothing or heavy post-processing.
